items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee mentions 'Abe -- the arranger and conductor for Paul Whiteman' and the interviewer clarifies 'Abe Osser?'. The interviewee does not explicitly confirm a personal relationship with Len Osser, nor does he mention Len Osser by name in his turn. The mention of 'Abe' (likely Abe Osser, Le

ctx.x: Well, at that time, also, I went in and did the Paul Whiteman Hour, and we had half of Paul Whiteman's original band in there, for that matter, Pingatore and Joe Tardoe, Curt Deiderly on the violin. And we had Abe -- the arranger
and conductor for Paul Whiteman. (Len Osser, Abe something.
